> **Claim rules (认领规则):**
> 1. One open claim per volunteer at a time — finish or release before claiming another.
> 2. A maintainer will assign this Issue to you. The task board status then flips to `inprogress`.
> 3. **14-day rule:** if there is no update on this Issue for 14 days, the claim is automatically
>    released and the task returns to `open`. Comment here if you need more time — that's always fine.
> 4. Submit your translation as a Pull Request referencing this Issue (`Closes #NNN`).
>    File format and style guide: see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
